items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: When I was with Lucky's band we were in Philadelphia and I got a telegram from Fletcher Henderson

ctx.x: Mills' Blue Rhythm Band. When I was with Lucky's band we were in Philadelphia and I got a telegram from Fletcher Henderson, asking me to call him. I've got it in the scrapbook. He said, "I want to talk to you about Red Allen." That's when Red and I went with Fletcher. We'd switch around like that.
So this was during the 30's that you were switching around in the bands?
